copy: Find clear answers about API access, authentication, usage limits, billing, and the tools that power your media workflow.
Our support team can help with account-specific questions.
Linkify Media is a developer-focused media intelligence API for discovering movies, TV shows, and anime, then returning structured metadata and useful discovery links through a unified interface.
How do I get an API key?
Create an account from the Linkify Media homepage, then open your Developer Dashboard. From there, choose
, give the key a recognizable name, and store it securely.
How do I authenticate an API request?
Send your API key in the
request header. Never expose a private key in browser-side code, public repositories, screenshots, or client applications.
What can the search endpoint return?
Depending on the matched title, the response can include the official title, release year, genres, runtime, ratings, poster URL, cast information, and links to relevant media platforms.
How do rate limits and quotas work?
Your daily allowance depends on your current plan. The Developer Dashboard shows your request volume, quota usage, and recent activity so you can monitor consumption before reaching a limit.
Can I create more than one API key?
Yes, where your plan allows it. Using separate named keys for environments such as development, staging, and production makes rotation and monitoring easier.
What should I do if I lose access to my account?

Use the available account recovery flow first. If you still cannot sign in, contact support with the account email and enough context for us to verify ownership. Do not send your API key in a support message.
When do I need a paid plan?
A paid plan may be useful when your product needs higher request limits, additional key capacity, or heavier batch workloads. Check the current plan details in the dashboard before upgrading.
How can I manage billing or cancel a plan?
Open the billing area from your dashboard to review the current plan and available account actions. For payment-specific questions, contact support using the details below.
How should I protect my API key?

Keep keys in server-side environment variables or a secrets manager. Do not place them in frontend JavaScript, commit them to source control, or share them in screenshots. Revoke and replace a key immediately if it may have been exposed.
Why is my API request returning an error?

Start by checking the endpoint, query parameters, API-key header, plan quota, and response status code. If the request still fails, send support the endpoint, status code, timestamp, and a redacted request example—never the secret key itself.
Where can I find integration examples?

Visit the API documentation for endpoint details, request examples, response structures, and authentication guidance. You can also use the interactive playground on the homepage to test a request before integrating it.

copy: This policy explains what information Linkify Media collects, why we use it, and the choices available to you.
We collect information needed to provide accounts, API access, support, and usage controls.
Access controls, password hashing, and operational safeguards help protect account data.
You can contact us about access, correction, deletion, or questions about your information.

This Privacy Policy applies to the Linkify Media website, dashboard, API services, and related support interactions. It describes our handling of information when you create an account, use our API, contact support, or browse the service.
Email address, name, password credentials, account preferences, subscription tier, and account identifiers.
API key identifiers, endpoint paths, timestamps, response status, and usage counts used for quotas and diagnostics.
Information you choose to include when contacting support, such as your email, issue description, and technical context.
Basic browser, device, security, and server information may be processed to operate and protect the service.

We use information to create and maintain accounts, authenticate requests, provide media metadata services, enforce plan limits, measure usage, prevent abuse, send service communications, respond to support requests, process subscriptions, and improve reliability.
We do not use developer API activity to sell personal profiles or expose private account information to other customers.

We may share limited information with service providers that help us operate the platform, such as hosting, email delivery, payment processing, authentication, logging, and media metadata providers. These providers receive information needed for their defined service role and are expected to handle it appropriately.

We may also disclose information where reasonably necessary to comply with law, enforce our terms, protect the security of the service, investigate abuse, or protect the rights and safety of users and others.

We use reasonable technical and organisational safeguards appropriate to the information we process. Passwords are stored using Django's password hashing system. Access to operational data is limited according to role and service needs.

We retain account and usage information for as long as needed to provide the service, enforce agreements, meet operational requirements, resolve disputes, and comply with applicable obligations. Retention periods may vary depending on the type and purpose of the information.
While your account is active and as needed for legitimate records.
Retained for quotas, analytics, security, and troubleshooting.
Retained as needed to resolve and document support matters.

Linkify Media may use essential session technologies to keep you signed in, protect forms, maintain security, and remember necessary service state. We may also use limited operational analytics where configured. You can control cookies through your browser, although disabling essential cookies may affect account functionality.

Legal Documentation

Privacy Policy

This policy explains what information Linkify Media collects, why we use it, and the choices available to you.

Last updated

August 5, 2026

Limited collection

We collect information needed to provide accounts, API access, support, and usage controls.

Security focused

Access controls, password hashing, and operational safeguards help protect account data.

Your choices

You can contact us about access, correction, deletion, or questions about your information.

On this page

Information we collectHow we use informationSharing and providersSecurity and retentionYour choices and rightsContact us
1

Scope of this policy

This Privacy Policy applies to the Linkify Media website, dashboard, API services, and related support interactions. It describes our handling of information when you create an account, use our API, contact support, or browse the service.

2

Information we collect

Account information

Email address, name, password credentials, account preferences, subscription tier, and account identifiers.

API activity

API key identifiers, endpoint paths, timestamps, response status, and usage counts used for quotas and diagnostics.

Support information

Information you choose to include when contacting support, such as your email, issue description, and technical context.

Technical information

Basic browser, device, security, and server information may be processed to operate and protect the service.

3

How we use information

We use information to create and maintain accounts, authenticate requests, provide media metadata services, enforce plan limits, measure usage, prevent abuse, send service communications, respond to support requests, process subscriptions, and improve reliability.

We do not use developer API activity to sell personal profiles or expose private account information to other customers.

4

Sharing and third-party providers

We may share limited information with service providers that help us operate the platform, such as hosting, email delivery, payment processing, authentication, logging, and media metadata providers. These providers receive information needed for their defined service role and are expected to handle it appropriately.

We may also disclose information where reasonably necessary to comply with law, enforce our terms, protect the security of the service, investigate abuse, or protect the rights and safety of users and others.

5

Security and retention

We use reasonable technical and organisational safeguards appropriate to the information we process. Passwords are stored using Django's password hashing system. Access to operational data is limited according to role and service needs.

We retain account and usage information for as long as needed to provide the service, enforce agreements, meet operational requirements, resolve disputes, and comply with applicable obligations. Retention periods may vary depending on the type and purpose of the information.

Account data

While your account is active and as needed for legitimate records.

Usage logs

Retained for quotas, analytics, security, and troubleshooting.

Support records

Retained as needed to resolve and document support matters.

6

Cookies and sessions

Linkify Media may use essential session technologies to keep you signed in, protect forms, maintain security, and remember necessary service state. We may also use limited operational analytics where configured. You can control cookies through your browser, although disabling essential cookies may affect account functionality.

7

Your choices and rights

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights to request access to, correction of, deletion of, or information about the processing of your personal information. You may also be able to object to or restrict certain processing.

To make a request, contact us using the address below. We may need to verify your identity and clarify the scope of your request before responding.

8

Children's privacy

The service is intended for developers and businesses and is not directed to children. If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us so we can review and take appropriate action.

9

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when our services, providers, or legal obligations change. We will update the date at the top of this page and may provide additional notice for material changes where appropriate.

Contact us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to submit a privacy request, contact:
